# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.2

This prerelease adds the browser-extension integration, date-effective class transfers and single-lesson transfer cancellation, scoped today's-schedule visibility, and mobile usability fixes since v2.0.0-alpha.1.

## Highlights

- Browser extension integration: pairing with revocable, extension-scoped credentials, a workspace API for catalog/field mappings, history report import with preview, reconciliation and lifecycle receipts, and a rebuilt provider view (weekly to-do, class roster cards, lesson report cards, quick attendance tiles and an attendance summary you can copy).
- Class transfers take effect from a chosen date and are recorded in a class history; report placeholders follow the enrollment start date and back-dated lessons are filled in before syncing.
- Single-lesson transfers can be cancelled from the class page and the transfer history, are authorized by RBAC (`teaching.enrollments.update` in both classes) as well as by teacher assignment, and show why a transfer was rejected.
- Today's schedule is decided per teaching role and per system, classroom or class scope: all classes, assigned classes only, or hidden. Classrooms and classes set it next to report notifications under "Role settings".
- Student creation and sensitive-data access follow platform and scoped permissions; blank student emails are stored as empty.

## Fixed before release

- iOS Safari no longer zooms in when an input gains focus and stays zoomed; pinch zoom still works. The font-size steppers no longer zoom on double tap.
- The class page's live-status popover opens rightward instead of being clipped by the sidebar.
- Class-day calendar, fixed-size realtime status badge, and the landing page account button were polished.
- The release image check now sets the required `EDULOG_WEB_BASE_URL`, so the API container starts during verification.

## Behaviour changes to note

- `system.dashboard.schedule.all` is removed (migration 1000147). System owners and administrators no longer see every class in today's schedule because of their system role; give them a teaching role set to "All classes" if they need it. No schedule policies are seeded, so review "System settings › Today's schedule visibility" after upgrading.
- The API source is reorganised into `config/`, `http/`, `infra/`, `auth/`, `domain/`, `routes/rest|pages|extension/`, `realtime/` and `openapi/`; the entry point remains `dist/index.js`.

## Images and deployment prerequisites

- Frontend: `ghcr.io/kenny1203520/edulog:2.0.0-alpha.2`
- API: `ghcr.io/kenny1203520/edulog-api:2.0.0-alpha.2`
- Alpha images do not update `latest`, `2`, or `2.0`. Use matching explicit versions for both services.
- This release does not deploy or migrate the existing production environment.
- Back up the database, then apply every unapplied migration in filename order through `1000147_dashboard_schedule_scoped_visibility.sql` (alpha.1 ended at 1000115). Follow `docs/deployment/rollout-1000142-1000146.md` for 1000142–1000146 and run the integration fixtures named in `supabase/migrations/README.md`.
- To use the browser extension, set `API_EXTENSION_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` to the exact `chrome-extension://<id>` origins and `EDULOG_WEB_BASE_URL` to the browser-facing frontend URL; see `docs/deployment/web-extension.md`. The extension is loaded from `extension/` and is not part of the container images.
- Returning to an older image does not reverse schema migrations. Verify restoration against a backup before planning a downgrade.

## Known limitations and follow-up

- Alpha evaluation release; the final 2.0 feature set is still being completed.
- OAuth callback routes and a Storage proxy remain unavailable.
- The Playwright workflow is scaffolding only: it contains the generated example test and runs on `main`/`master`.
- Track remaining work and promotion criteria in `docs/deployment/alpha-roadmap.md`.

## Verification

- Frontend: 513 tests passed; production typecheck/build passed.
- API: 289 tests passed; typecheck/build passed.
- PostgreSQL migration chain through 1000147 and the clean-install integration fixtures (including `dashboard_schedule_visibility_integration.sql`) passed in an isolated database; the full CI database gate runs on the release tag.
- iOS input zoom fix checked on an iPhone.
